$comment: Explore cold start (T3.10): curated comprehensible-input channels for Japanese. Names only (no YouTube fetch, no Data API) — links are YouTube searches by name. Levels are a suggestion. Curated 2026-10-30; see docs/plans/2026-10-30-explore-spec.md for sources and what was left out.

channels.name: Comprehensible Japanese
channels.note: Picture-supported stories in slow, simple Japanese; graded from complete beginner up.

channels.name: Nihongo no Jikan
channels.note: Short comprehensible-input videos graded from complete beginner to advanced.

channels.name: Learn Japanese with Noriko
channels.note: Everyday topics in easy Japanese with visual support.

channels.name: Akane's Japanese Class
channels.note: Easy Japanese listening on daily life, spoken slowly.

channels.name: Nihongo con Teppei
channels.note: Short podcast episodes; the beginner series is a gentle first step into audio-only input.

channels.name: Japanese Ammo with Misa
channels.note: Grammar lessons explained mostly in English — good for structure, less pure input.

channels.name: Japanese with Shun
channels.note: Natural conversations and vlogs with Japanese subtitles.

channels.name: Speak Japanese Naturally
channels.note: Monologues on culture and daily life in natural-speed Japanese.

channels.name: Miku Real Japanese
channels.note: Real-life spoken Japanese and casual expressions.

channels.name: YuYu no Nihongo Podcast
channels.note: Podcast in clear, natural Japanese about life and culture.

channels.name: Onomappu
channels.note: Japanese-only talks and podcasts with Japanese subtitles.

channels.name: Sayuri Saying
channels.note: Talks about Japanese life and language, mostly in Japanese.

channels.name: Nihongo no Mori
channels.note: JLPT N3–N1 grammar and vocabulary explained in Japanese.
